verdict.rationale: The evidence shows enterprise-focused APIs (Admin, Analytics, AI Code Tracking) and an OpenTelemetry export for team usage telemetry, but none of these constitute a user-facing 'export all my data in open formats and leave' capability — there's no documented way for an individual user to export their chat history, prompts, settings, or account data to migrate away from Cursor. Code itself lives in standard git repos, but that's incidental, not a stated data-portability/export feature.
